title: Arithmetic competence: paired training-budget and weight-decay development screen
scope: A new bounded development stage informed by P1-A0; not confirmation or a history-observer study.
rationale: P1-A0 had a large train/calibration gap after 1200 updates. Test longer training with a paired decoupled-weight-decay contrast, retaining task, architecture and exposed development split.

preserved.architecture: P1-A0 six-step weight-tied encoder; width24 heads2 feedforward48; 5873 parameters
preserved.data_source: Exact P1-A0 canonical-family split and train/calibration examples; these calibration outcomes are exposed development data, not untouched confirmation.
preserved.reserved_example_policy: Do not expand, train on, or evaluate reserved families.
preserved.loss: Final-step cross entropy only; no intermediate supervision

design.sampling_seed_rule: 500000 + model_seed; NumPy PCG64 with-replacement index matrix [6000,64], int64
design.pairing: Identical initial weights and complete batch-index matrix within each model-seed pair; train both arms from initialization, not the old checkpoint.

optimizer.implementation: Original P1-A0 Adam plus decoupled multiplicative decay of parameter matrices BEFORE the Adam update, using gradients computed at pre-decay parameters.
optimizer.decay_parameters: Every trainable tensor with ndim >= 2: token and position embeddings and linear weights. Exclude all biases and LayerNorm scale/bias vectors.
optimizer.justification: Weight decay and longer training have precedent in algorithmic generalization research. Lambda=1 is a fixed literature-motivated development candidate, not an optimum; matrix-only decay and the smaller tied architecture differ from that literature.

measurements.primary_contrast: Final calibration exact-answer accuracy: matrix_decay minus no_decay, paired by model seed; report both differences and their arithmetic mean descriptively.
measurements.budget_diagnostic: Within each arm/seed, report accuracy at 1200,3000,6000 without selecting a best checkpoint.
measurements.competence_gate_rationale: Same declared development readiness threshold as P1-A0, not a validated deployment criterion.
measurements.descriptive_limit: Two new initialization seeds on the same exposed development families do not establish out-of-sample model/population generalization or an untouched replication.

decisions.arm_ready: Both seeds complete all updates, final accuracy >=90% for both, and at least two of steps2..5 satisfy all target-count/family/prevalence gates for BOTH seeds.
decisions.one_ready: The passing arm is a development candidate for later observer-protocol design, not automatic probe fitting or confirmation.
decisions.none_ready: Close this bounded competence screen with no ready regimen; do not add updates, select a best seed, or fit history predictors.
decisions.numeric_or_method_failure: Mark study incomplete/invalid, preserve diagnostics, stop; no replacement run within this protocol.
decisions.next_boundary: Any further competence recipe or observer study requires its own justification and frozen protocol; retain every current failure and the sealed old/reserved data.

artifacts.full_states: Regenerate from frozen weights and exact inputs to keep the archive compact. No observer fitting is performed.
artifacts.notebook: Standalone NumPy Colab; method checks and recorded report by default; full development reproduction is explicitly opt-in.
